name: wpewebkit

archive_signature.method: gpg --verify of the official detached wpewebkit-2.54.2.tar.xz.asc using the signer key fetched from keys.openpgp.org by fingerprint; recomputed archive SHA-256 equals the official release page.
archive_signature.caveats: The key is not certified through a web of trust here: verification proves the archive was signed by this key, not independently who holds it. The DSA-1024 key expires 2027-03-16; releases after that need renewal checked. The annotated Git tag is independently signature-verified with the same key.

tag_signature.method: git verify-tag --raw wpewebkit-2.54.2 in an isolated GNUPGHOME; VALIDSIG matches the archive signer fingerprint.
tag_signature.caveats: Signer identity is not independently certified; the archive/commit correspondence below is separately measured.

product_source.fetch: git fetch --depth=1 --filter=blob:none <repository> <commit>: trees only (about 14 MB); blobs of the checkout paths are fetched on demand
notes: The signed annotated tag binds the commit; its tree id pins every file. ls_tree_sha256 and tree_entries additionally pin the complete recursive listing.

The WPE tarball stays the *reference* source (WPE baseline, JSCOnly, 3A). This source exists because the tarball has no Windows port (no PlatformWin.cmake, no Windows IPC backend) and PlatformCRT's Mac/Win reference reading needs the whole tree.
Nothing from this tree is patched in place. A PlatformCRT file is either a new CRT-owned file or a recorded patch (libcrtweb/patches/manifest.json) with its license class.

tarball_correspondence.reading: Every shared regular file is byte-identical to the tagged commit, except 130 ANGLE files that match after CRLF-to-LF normalization. Zero content differences. The tarball-only files are generated Documentation and NEWS; PlatformCRT uses the full commit for the additional Source files.

license.summary: Mixed per-file licensing. License files in the archive: LGPL-2 and LGPL-2.1 texts (Source/WebCore/LICENSE-LGPL-2, LICENSE-LGPL-2.1, Source/JavaScriptCore/COPYING.LIB), an Apple BSD-style 2-clause notice (Source/WebCore/LICENSE-APPLE), and bundled third-party components each with their own license file. Per-file headers: see license-scan.json (Apple/WebKit BSD-2-Clause and BSD-3-Clause are the bulk of the code, LGPL-2+/2.1+ the rest of WebKit's own; bundled components keep their licenses).
license.scan_status: Regenerated 2026-10-27 for 2.54.2: 64 unchanged license/notice files in license-inventory.json; 69,600 product-tree files classified in license-scan.json. All 23 carried patch definitions are unchanged; 16 before/after hashes were refreshed for seven changed upstream files. Linux/macOS/Windows patch selections apply with zero fuzz; native compilation/replay is a separate gate.

confirmed_from_primary_sources: Official release page: WPE WebKit 2.54.2, stable 2.54 series, released 2026-10-23. Downloaded archive is 49,565,492 bytes; SHA-256 f3284e19e47fcb5ac8c63c2e1c113dbd65b2423eb8a545f5b345707829004f56 matches the published checksum.

Both detached archive signature and annotated Git tag signature verify with fingerprint 5AA3BC334FD7E3369E7C77B291C559DBE4C9123B; tag object 6c294e37d744618c3f9983b44c7759b8265ecf63 peels to product_source.commit.

Complete recursive Git listing matches product_source tree/count/digest; every shared tarball file matches the commit by Git blob id, allowing only measured ANGLE line-ending normalization. See product_source.tarball_correspondence.

License-file inventory and per-file Source header scan regenerated from these identified bytes. No license/notice file changed from 2.54.1; the header scanner still reports unknown classes explicitly.

Official advisory/release indexes checked through tools/check_webkit_security.py: pin_is_latest_micro=true, series_within_grace=true, passed=true; latest listed advisory WSA-2026-0006. This is a version-bound check, not security certification.
Prior 2.54.0/2.54.1 bring-up and native acceptance remain historical evidence in docs/acceptance/crtweb_acceptance.md and sdk_split_acceptance.md; they do not establish native 2.54.2 replay.
not_yet_verified: Native PlatformCRT compile/run/SDK packaging on the new 2.54.2 pin remains a release-qualification gate; applying other-host patch selections on Linux is not native macOS/Windows replay.
No public upstream end-of-life guarantee is inferred; the adopted CRT support-window policy remains in docs/design/libcrtweb_api_policy.md.

import.status: 2.54.2 source pin, archive/tag signatures, correspondence and licensing verified; native compile/run acceptance follows in release qualification.
import.fetch: tools/fetch_webkit.py for the verified release tarball; tools/fetch_webkit_commit.py for the pinned full PlatformCRT product tree.
notes: The archive has no commit header. Its detached signature and the annotated tag signature are verified independently; complete tarball/tree correspondence binds the source bytes.
WPE WebKit 2.54 is the reference and structural model for PlatformCRT, a separate platform implementation (docs/porting/crtweb_porting.md).

Do not patch upstream source to hide a missing CRT/PAL surface (AGENTS.md porting loop). Any carried patch needs a row in docs/porting/crtweb_porting.md with its upstream reference and removal condition.

support_window.upstream_rule: Only the latest stable release branch (even minor number) receives security updates; fixes are generally not backported (docs.webkit.org SecurityUpdates).
support_window.upstream_cadence: Two feature releases a year, typically March and September (wpewebkit.org/release/schedule).
support_window.observed: 2.54.2 is the newest micro in the pinned series in the official release index checked 2026-10-27. Prior series-cadence observations remain historical; the executable support-window gate is authoritative at assembly time.
support_window.crt_policy: adopted 2026-10-21: public release allowed up to 60 days after the next stable series first ships; re-pin starts within 30 days (docs/design/libcrtweb_api_policy.md)

security_policy.rule: A pinned version is affected by an advisory when it is older than the advisory's fixed version. Re-check the pin against every new advisory; see docs/acceptance/crtweb_acceptance.md Tranche 0.

public_api_policy: No WebKit, WPE or GLib type, macro or header appears in any installed libcrtweb or crtui header.
tools/verify_dist.py (stage 06-web) will fail if a WebKit/WPE/GLib header leaks into the public SDK, as it already does for LVGL in 05-ui.
